name: write-docs
description: Procedural guide for writing documentation that lands. Identifies the Diátaxis mode (tutorial / how-to / reference / explanation), picks the shape that fits the mode, applies Google + Microsoft line-level style rules, and treats the README as a special landing-page form modeled on SpacetimeDB / Tokio / RocksDB / Qdrant / Stripe. Names anti-patterns the way release-check names tooling-generated changelog entries — explicit, with examples.
